pos.personaBrief: No verified tactical evidence (only the career table: titles with Espérance 2023-24 and Sundowns 2024-25); from general knowledge, Cardoso's teams, especially Sundowns, are possession-dominant sides that control games with the ball.

pro.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge his teams build patiently from the back under pressure but look for vertical, line-breaking passes and use the long ball when a runner is free.

est.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he is a methodical Portuguese coach of the positional school, with rehearsed positions and spread occupation, while allowing the striker and wingers some movement.

lar.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge his sides use width through wingers and full-backs to stretch blocks, rather than funnelling everything through the centre, without relying only on crosses.

blo.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge his teams press high and counter-press immediately after losing the ball, consistent with a dominant title-winning side.

mar.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he uses modern zonal defending referenced to space and ball, without dedicated man-markers.

pla.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he arrives with a defined game model and keeps it whatever the opponent, adjusting details rather than the identity.

res.personaBrief: No verified evidence; the only verified facts are titles, and from general knowledge he values a recognisable style but is judged and driven by winning at title-hunting clubs, closing games when needed.

sis.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he is a system coach whose collective organisation comes first and applies tactical duties to everyone, while still valuing individual dribblers.

jog.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he favours technical players able to play through pressure, while demanding modern intensity from everyone.

bas.personaBrief: No verified evidence; his counted spells are at big, title-obliged clubs (Espérance, Sundowns) built largely through signings, so from general knowledge he leans on experienced players.

lid.personaBrief: No verified evidence; from general knowledge he is a demanding, rule-setting coach who still values group cohesion and dialogue with leaders.
